_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for FACT-GUARDIAN validation script
_meta.update_policy: Only update after web-verified primary source confirmation. Never update from base model output.
_meta.cross_ai_review: Every batch verified by Groq (llama-3.1-8b-instant) + Gemini (gemini-1.5-flash) before commit

paye_band_2_rate.fact: PAYE second band rate is 8% on income between TZS 270,001 and TZS 520,000
paye_band_2_rate.unresolved_note: Confirm via TRA IDRAS calculator before batch_004

paye_penalty_rate.fact: Late PAYE remittance penalty is 2.5% per month of unpaid amount

paye_personal_relief.fact: PAYE personal relief is TZS 26,000 per month — NOT 27,000
paye_personal_relief.verified_by: AfroTools TRA 2025/26 web confirmed June 2026. Perplexity claimed 27,000 — REJECTED by web research.

paye_p9_deadline.fact: Annual PAYE reconciliation Form P9 deadline is 31 March of following year — NOT 31 January
paye_p9_deadline.verified_by: PaySpace, Deel, Rivermate — multiple sources confirmed 31 March

p45_not_tanzanian.fact: Form P45 does not exist in Tanzania — it is a UK payroll form. Use P9 or leaving certificate.
p45_not_tanzanian.correct_value: No P45 in Tanzania — use P9 or leaving certificate
p45_not_tanzanian.verified_by: TRA website — P45 not mentioned anywhere in Tanzania tax law

sdl_rate.fact: SDL rate is 3.5% of gross payroll — NOT 4%

sdl_full_name.fact: SDL stands for Skills Development Levy — NOT Service Delivery Levy and NOT short-term disability leave
wrong_patterns: SDL stands for Service Delivery Levy
SDL stands for Skills Delivery Levy
SDL inahusu ulemavu wa muda mfupi
sdl_full_name.adversarial_note: Base model inference test after 300 pairs STILL said disability leave — needs 50+ adversarial pairs in batch_003

sdl_threshold.fact: SDL applies to employers with 10 or more employees on Mainland Tanzania — NOT 4 employees
wrong_patterns: sdl.*\b5 employees\b(?! or more| au zaidi)
sdl_threshold.verified_by: Finance Act 2021 — changed threshold from 4 to 10

sdl_payer.fact: SDL is paid by the employer only — NOT deducted from employee wages
wrong_patterns: SDL inakatwa kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi
SDL is deducted from the employee
SDL is deducted from employee salary

nssf_employer_rate.fact: NSSF employer contribution is 10% of gross wage — NOT 6%
nssf_employer_rate.verified_by: NSSF official website — inference test after 300 pairs confirmed 10% is now learned
nssf_employer_rate.adversarial_note: Base model frequently says 6% — confirmed fixed after 300-pair training

nssf_total_rate.fact: NSSF total contribution is 20% of gross wage (10% employer + 10% employee)

nssf_penalty.fact: NSSF late payment penalty is 5% per month of unpaid contributions

nssf_retirement_age.fact: NSSF retirement age is 60 (55 for mining/early retirement), minimum 180 months contributions for full pension

vat_standard_rate.fact: Tanzania VAT standard rate is 18% — unchanged since 2015. It was NEVER 14%.
wrong_patterns: kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT ni asilimia 16
Tanzania VAT ni 16% kwa bidhaa zote
vat_standard_rate.verified_by: TRA VAT page — history section confirms 18% since 2015
vat_standard_rate.adversarial_note: Inference test showed model inventing 5% food VAT and 10% utilities VAT — needs adversarial pairs

vat_reduced_rates.fact: Tanzania does NOT have reduced VAT rates of 5% or 10%. Only 18% standard, 0% zero-rated, and exempt.
vat_reduced_rates.correct_value: No 5% or 10% reduced rates exist in Tanzania
wrong_patterns: Tanzania ina kiwango cha 5% cha VAT
Tanzania ina kiwango cha 10% cha VAT
Tanzania ina kiwango kilichopunguzwa cha VAT
Tanzania has a reduced VAT rate
vat_reduced_rates.verified_by: TRA VAT Act — only standard 18%, zero-rated 0%, exempt
vat_reduced_rates.adversarial_note: CRITICAL — inference test showed model confidently saying 5% for food and 10% for utilities. Needs 40+ adversarial pairs in batch_003

vat_registration_threshold.fact: VAT registration threshold is TZS 200,000,000 per year OR TZS 100,000,000 per 6 months
vat_registration_threshold.verified_by: TRA VAT page confirmed matching RSM 2025/26 guide

vat_withholding_goods.fact: VAT withholding on goods is 3% — effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025)

vat_withholding_services.fact: VAT withholding on services is 6% — effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025)

gn487a_nature.fact: GN487A is a BUSINESS PROHIBITION ORDER listing 15 activities non-citizens cannot conduct. It is NOT about immigration or residence permits.
gn487a_nature.correct_value: Business prohibition order — 15 prohibited business activities
wrong_patterns: raia wa kigeni lazima waomba kibali ndani ya
gn 487a ni amri ya uhamiaji wa makazi
gn 487a is a residence permit order
gn 487a is an immigration permit order
gn 487a requires non-citizens to apply for residence
gn487a_nature.verified_by: TanzLII gazette text + Bowmans Tanzania legal update
gn487a_nature.adversarial_note: CRITICAL — inference test after 300 pairs showed model STILL saying GN487A is about residence permits. Needs 80 adversarial pairs in batch_003. HIGHEST PRIORITY.

gn487a_effective_date.fact: GN 487A came into effect on 28 July 2025

gn487a_penalty_noncitizen.fact: GN 487A penalty for non-citizen: minimum TZS 10,000,000 fine AND/OR up to 6 months imprisonment AND visa revocation

gn487a_penalty_citizen_facilitator.fact: GN 487A penalty for Tanzanian citizen who facilitates non-citizen: TZS 5,000,000 OR 3 months imprisonment
gn487a_penalty_citizen_facilitator.correct_value: TZS 5M or 3 months for facilitating citizen

gn605a_effective_date.fact: GN 605A Private Sector Wage Order came into effect on 1 January 2026

gn605a_average_increase.fact: GN 605A average increase is 33.4% from TZS 275,060 to TZS 358,322 per month
gn605a_average_increase.verified_by: Business and Human Rights Centre — Minister Kikwete press briefing October 2025

royalties_wht_rate.fact: Withholding tax on royalties is 15% for BOTH residents and non-residents

provisional_tax_instalments.fact: Provisional tax is paid in FOUR equal instalments at end of months 3, 6, 9, and 12 from start of financial year
provisional_tax_instalments.verified_by: TRA Paying Taxes page + PWC Tanzania + Auditax International

minimum_turnover_tax.fact: Tanzania minimum turnover tax is 1% of gross turnover effective 1 July 2025 — was 0.5%, never 0.3%

commissioner_objection_deadline.fact: TRA Commissioner must determine an objection within 6 months from date of admission — NOT 90 days
commissioner_objection_deadline.verified_by: Finance Act 2020 amendment to Tax Administration Act confirmed by PWC

trab_appeal_two_steps.fact: TRAB appeal requires TWO steps: (1) Notice of Intention within 30 days AND (2) Statement of Appeal within 45 days
trab_appeal_two_steps.correct_value: 30-day notice + 45-day statement of appeal — both mandatory

objection_deposit_requirement.fact: Before TRA objection is admitted taxpayer must pay the HIGHER of undisputed tax OR one-third of assessed tax within 15 days
objection_deposit_requirement.correct_value: Pay higher of undisputed OR 1/3 assessed within 15 days
objection_deposit_requirement.verified_by: TRA Objections page + FB Attorneys Tanzania. Was MISSING from original batch_002 pairs.

objection_extension_statutory_right.fact: Extension of the 30-day objection period is a STATUTORY RIGHT — NOT very rare. Apply within 7 days before expiry.
objection_extension_statutory_right.correct_value: Statutory right — apply 7 days before expiry, max 30 more days
objection_extension_statutory_right.verified_by: TRA Objections page — extension explicitly provided by law

stamp_duty_property_transfer.fact: Stamp duty on transfer of land or buildings is a FLAT 1% of consideration or market value — NOT tiered 0.5%/1%

permit_class_b_employed.fact: Class B Residence Permit is for EMPLOYED EXPATRIATES working for companies — NOT for investors

permit_class_a_investor.fact: Class A Residence Permit is for SELF-EMPLOYED FOREIGN INVESTORS — NOT Class B

permit_class_c_categories.fact: Class C Residence Permit is for researchers, retired persons, missionaries, volunteers — NOT for employed foreign workers
permit_class_c_categories.correct_value: Class C = researchers, missionaries, volunteers, retired
wrong_patterns: employed.{0,30}Class C(?! is for| ni kwa)

corporate_tax_rate.fact: Tanzania standard corporate income tax rate is 30%. DSE-listed companies pay 25%.

wht_deadline.fact: Withholding tax must be remitted within 7 DAYS after end of the calendar month — NOT 7th of following month
wht_deadline.note: PAYE deadline = 7th of following month. WHT deadline = 7 DAYS after month end. These are different.

loss_carryforward_finance_act_2024.fact: After 4 consecutive years of tax losses only 60% of year 5 income can be offset against losses (Finance Act 2024)
loss_carryforward_finance_act_2024.correct_value: 60% offset limit after 4 consecutive loss years

brela_share_transfer_legal_effect.fact: Share transfer without BRELA notification MAY LACK LEGAL EFFECT AGAINST THIRD PARTIES — it is not absolutely void
brela_share_transfer_legal_effect.correct_value: May lack legal effect against third parties

tmda_replaces_tfda.fact: TMDA (Tanzania Medicines and Medical Devices Authority) is the current name — TFDA no longer exists

brave_search_blocked_tanzania.fact: Brave Search API is blocked in Tanzania. TRA required Brave Software to register as non-resident electronic service provider. Brave blocked Tanzania access instead of registering.
brave_search_blocked_tanzania.correct_value: Do not use Brave Search for this project — use Groq and Gemini APIs instead
brave_search_blocked_tanzania.note: This is a project configuration fact not a regulatory fact. Do NOT install Brave Search MCP.

commercial_rent_wht_nonresident.claim: Commercial rent WHT rate for non-residents

paye_band2_final_confirmation.claim: PAYE second band rate is definitively 8% not 9%
paye_band2_final_confirmation.resolution_source: TRA IDRAS system — log in and check PAYE calculator directly
paye_band2_final_confirmation.note: One Perplexity source disputed — confirm via IDRAS before batch_004 PAYE pairs

moa_stamp_duty.claim: Memorandum of Association stamp duty is TZS 10,000
moa_stamp_duty.resolution_source: Current Stamp Duty Act schedule or TRA stamp duty page

wht_penalty_rate.claim: Withholding tax specific late penalty rate
wht_penalty_rate.resolution_source: Tax Administration Act — WHT-specific penalty section
